items.name: Emerald Valley
items.subtitle: 1.21 Bedrock · 1.21 Java
items.description: Explore a peaceful valley surrounded by tall stone cliffs, with two villages near spawn and a third settlement just beyond the river. Follow the mountain trails to find hidden waterfalls, deep cave entrances and a sheltered lake for your first base. A pillager outpost stands on the ridge above the villages, creating an early challenge for adventurous players. Gather food and wood before heading underground, bring plenty of torches, and watch your step around the ravines while exploring this world with friends.
